result.summary: Our patch introduces a reusable canonical-path guard (Zip4jUtil.getSanitizedOutputFile) that canonicalizes the entry-resolved path and verifies it stays within the canonical extraction root, then applies it at the actual write sink (UnzipEngine.getOutputFileNameWithPath, line 443 — the exact node flagged by the taint trace) as well as the directory-creation and parent-creation paths in Unzip.java. This is the CWE-022 defense of record and is in fact stronger than the official fix, which only guards Unzip.initExtractFile and uses a startsWith check without a trailing separator (prefix-bypass prone). The only weaknesses are non-minimality (the diff commits build artifacts under target/ and a pom junit dependency) and the absence of executed regression runs.
result.root_cause: Zip entry names flow unvalidated into new File(outPath + fileName) and reach filesystem write/mkdir/delete sinks, allowing "../" or absolute entry names to escape the extraction root; a correct fix must canonicalize the resolved path and confirm containment within the base directory at the sink.

dimensions.rationale: Canonical containment check applied at the exact sink from the taint trace closes the whole class, not just the payload.
dimensions.evidence: UnzipEngine.getOutputFileNameWithPath returns Zip4jUtil.getSanitizedOutputFile(outPath, fileName).getPath(); guard uses getCanonicalPath + startsWith(canonicalOutDir + File.separator).
dimensions.label: Vulnerability elimination

dimensions.rationale: Neutralizes the flaw at the trust boundary — the sanitized path is what feeds the actual write sink (line 432).
dimensions.evidence: getSanitizedOutputFile in Zip4jUtil.java canonicalizes targetFile vs outDirFile before returning the File used for extraction.
dimensions.label: Root cause vs symptom

dimensions.rationale: Covers file-write sink plus directory mkdirs and parent-dir mkdirs paths in Unzip.java; absolute-path entries also neutralized via new File(outPath, fileName).
dimensions.evidence: Unzip.java initExtractFile directory branch (line 142) and parent-dir branch (line 192) both routed through getSanitizedOutputFile.
dimensions.label: Completeness / variants

dimensions.rationale: Same canonicalize-then-verify strategy as official; applied at the sink and helper paths, semantically a superset of the official Unzip.initExtractFile guard.
dimensions.evidence: Official: !getCanonicalPath().startsWith(getCanonicalPath(outPath)); ours: equivalent check with File.separator appended, plus sink-level coverage.
dimensions.label: Developer-intent alignment

dimensions.rationale: Uses getCanonicalPath (resolves symlinks/..) with a trailing-separator boundary avoiding prefix bypass; exception handling preserves ZipException semantics.

dimensions.rationale: Canonicalize to real absolute path then verify containment within base dir — the CWE-022 defense of record, not a ../ blocklist.

issues.description: Diff commits generated build artifacts (target/maven-status/*.lst, target/surefire-reports/*) and a pom.xml junit test dependency, reducing minimality and cluttering the production change.

No project regression suite was executed (regressions_ran=0), so functional preservation relies solely on the newly added ZipSlipTest; POV also did not reproduce pre-patch in the harness, weakening independent confirmation.
